recipes.title: Freezer Breakfast Sandwiches (sheet-pan egg bake)
steps: Egg bake
Heat the oven to 375°F (190°C). Grease a 9×13 dish and whisk in it the eggs, milk, salt, pepper and garlic powder. Stir in the broccoli, onion and pepper.
Bake
Bake about 25 minutes until set and starting to brown. In the last 5–10 minutes, bake the turkey bacon and deli meat on a sheet pan alongside.
Toast
Toast the English muffins under the broiler for a few minutes.
Assemble
Cool the eggs and cut into 6 squares. Layer an egg square, 2 pieces of bacon or 1 slice of deli meat, and a slice of cheese on each muffin.
Wrap & freeze
Wrap each sandwich in a damp paper towel, then parchment, and freeze in a bag for up to 1 month.
Reheat
Remove the parchment, keep the damp towel on and microwave 2–3 minutes.
recipes.notes: Recipe from Tasty's recipe card; macros are estimated (their listed numbers look too low for the ingredients).

recipes.title: Freezer Smoothie Packs (4 flavors)

items.i: milk of choice (1 cup for the kiwi one)

groups.name: Pineapple orange mango fruit bag (pick one)
Kiwi banana spinach fruit bag (pick one)

steps: Pack
Put one flavor's fruit in a freezer bag, seal and freeze (up to a few months).
Blend
When ready, blend the frozen fruit with the milk and Greek yogurt until smooth. For the kiwi version, blend the milk and spinach first, then add the yogurt and fruit.
recipes.notes: Recipes and macros from Tasty's cards; macros shown are for mixed berry, per smoothie. Others: strawberry banana 258 cal / 14 g protein, pineapple orange mango 318 / 15 g, kiwi banana spinach 321 / 18 g. Buy only the fruit for the flavor(s) you're making.

recipes.title: Healthy Sheet Tray Pancakes

items.i: blueberries, strawberries, banana slices and dark chocolate chips

steps: Mix
Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Mix the flour and baking powder, then add the milk, applesauce, eggs and vanilla and stir until combined.
Spread & top
Spread on a greased baking sheet and add toppings all over, or a different topping in each corner.
Bake
Bake 15 minutes, cut into squares. Serve, or freeze for up to a month.
recipes.notes: Recipe and macros from Tasty's card (per square, before toppings).

recipes.title: Healthier Freezer Breakfast Burritos (sweet potato & turkey bacon)
steps: Cook the fillings
In a large skillet cook the turkey bacon; set aside. In the same pan cook the sweet potato with salt and pepper until soft, then the bell pepper, then wilt the spinach, setting each aside.
Eggs
Lower the heat and softly scramble the eggs.
Assemble
On parchment, fill each tortilla with egg, sweet potato, spinach, pepper, chopped bacon and cheese. Fold in the sides, roll tightly and wrap in the parchment.
Freeze & reheat
Freeze up to 1 month. To reheat, unwrap, wrap in a damp paper towel and microwave about 3 minutes; rest 1 minute.
recipes.notes: Recipe from Tasty's card; macros are estimated per burrito (their listed numbers are clearly per-ingredient, not per burrito).

recipes.title: Strawberry Chocolate Overnight Oats
steps: Mix
In a mason jar stir together the oats, milk, Greek yogurt, cocoa and maple syrup.
Top & chill
Add the diced strawberries, seal and refrigerate overnight.
recipes.notes: Recipe and macros from Tasty's card.

recipes.title: Breakfast Egg Cups (muffin tin)
steps: Prep
Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C) and grease a 12-cup muffin tin.
Fill
Season the beaten eggs and pour into each cup about halfway, then add your choice of toppings.
Bake
Bake 20 minutes. Eat now or store in an airtight container in the fridge and reheat.
recipes.notes: Recipe and macros from Tasty's card (per egg cup).

recipes.title: No-Bake Almond Butter Honey Oat Bars (3 ingredients)
steps: Mix
Stir the oats, nut butter and honey together until fully combined.
Press
Spread evenly into a dish sprayed with cooking spray.
Freeze & cut
Cover and freeze until firm, then cut into bars. Keep in the fridge.
recipes.notes: Recipe and macros from Tasty's card.
